projects.title: Maintenance & Inventory Management Platform
projects.summary: A CMMS + IMS for an industrial services company: work orders, preventive maintenance, parts inventory and service operations in one system, with an AI plugin layer for operators.
outcomes: 67 operator workflows taken through UAT against a shared acceptance sheet
Plugin/MCP architecture lets AI assistants act on work orders safely
Requirements traceability (FRD → RTM → test cases) kept live with the code

projects.title: Guided-Tour Mobile App
projects.summary: An iOS-first React Native app for self-guided tours: location-aware stops, media playback and offline-friendly content, built from a signed SOW with full requirements traceability.
outcomes: Shipped through TestFlight to client UAT on a fixed timeline
Feature scope tracked card-by-card from kickoff to closure
Offline-tolerant content model for spotty connectivity on tours

projects.title: Client Financing Workflow Platform
projects.summary: A financing-application platform that moves applicants through intake, review, approval and deployment stages, with an integrations lane for third-party services.
outcomes: Production deployment with a staged QA → UAT → deploy pipeline
Integration backlog managed separately from core delivery
Client-side questions routed through a dedicated dev queue

projects.title: Field-Service Management System
projects.summary: Scheduling, dispatch and job tracking for a septic and service company, delivered across two phased SOWs with contract data driving the requirements documents.
outcomes: Two-phase delivery with a regenerable FRD/RTM/test-case suite
Containerised deploy with a one-command Makefile
Technician-facing flows designed for phone use in the field

projects.title: Due-Diligence Workflow with Role-Based Approvals
projects.summary: An MVP for running structured due-diligence checklists with coordinator and approver roles, sign-off gates and an auditable trail of decisions.
outcomes: RBAC model extended so approvers gain full coordinator parity
Team sign-off gates enforced in the UI and API
Docker Compose stack for one-command local and staging runs

projects.title: Knowledge & Authority Engine
projects.summary: A monorepo of LLM-driven engines that ingest a company's knowledge base and produce authority content, with structured build plans and versioned engine specs.
outcomes: Versioned engine specs kept in the repo alongside the code
Monorepo split into apps and packages for independent deploys
Conversation logs feed continuous prompt refinement

projects.title: Client-Facing Delivery Portal
projects.summary: An internal portal where clients follow delivery status, milestones and deliverables across projects, with a Fastify + Prisma backend and staged deploy scripts.
outcomes: Staging and production deploy scripts with health checks
Buyer-intent and marketing requirement sets traced to features
Every PR reviewed against the FRD before merge

projects.title: Certificate-of-Insurance Automation
projects.summary: Automates the collection, validation and expiry tracking of certificates of insurance from vendors, replacing a manual inbox-and-spreadsheet process.
outcomes: Fastify + Prisma service with typed request/response contracts
Document intake pipeline with structured extraction
Expiry reminders replace manual follow-up

projects.title: Email Triage Automation
projects.summary: An LLM-assisted service that reads a trades company's shared inbox, classifies requests, and routes them to the right queue, deployed on Cloud Run.
outcomes: Discovery-to-proposal-to-build in one repo with contract data
Cloud Build pipeline to Cloud Run with a single Dockerfile
Classification rules refined from real inbox samples

projects.title: Vehicle-Salvage Platform + AI Estimate OCR
projects.summary: Ongoing enhancement of a production vehicle-salvage platform, including an AI document-scanning workflow that extracts repair-estimate data with the OpenAI API.
outcomes: Repair-estimate data extraction automated end-to-end
Manual encoding effort and human error reduced
Mobile features aligned with day-to-day yard operations

projects.title: Fitness App with Multi-Source Health Sync
projects.summary: A React Native fitness app with interactive health and analytics dashboards that unifies Apple HealthKit, Oura and Garmin data into one mobile experience.
outcomes: Three wearable ecosystems synced into a single data model
Interactive dashboards with Victory Native
Performance tuned for large daily datasets

projects.title: Retail Supply-Chain & FinTech Mobile Suite
projects.summary: Five production apps connecting principals, supermarkets, distributors and sari-sari stores, plus a capital-assistance platform for digital business transactions.
outcomes: Five apps led end-to-end from architecture to store release
KPI dashboards for enterprise customers
Push notifications, deep linking and offline data handling

projects.title: Nuptl — Wedding Technology Startup
projects.summary: Founded and launched a wedding-planning product with both a React Native mobile app and a web platform, owning product and engineering direction.
outcomes: Mobile app and web platform launched from concept to production
Product architecture, frontend and backend integration owned solo

projects.title: Healthcare Appointment Platform
projects.summary: Patient, doctor and clinic workflows including appointment management, built on API-driven architectures.
outcomes: Customer-facing mobile and web flows for three user types
GraphQL data layer across mobile and web
